writes={"conversation.create","conversation.settings","conversation.unblock","conversation.rename","message.submit","message.steer","message.cancel","turn.interrupt","message.resolve","approval.respond","attachment.add","catalog.refresh","conversation.handoff"}

    assert descriptors.read_only(op,{})
for op in writes:
    assert not descriptors.read_only(op,{})
    assert not descriptors.read_only(op,{"conversation_id":"c","text":""})
for args in [{},{"text":None},{"text":""},{"text":"  "},{"text":"notice"},{"text":123}]:

    if isinstance(node,ast.With) and any(ast.unparse(item.context_expr)=="self._connection_lock" for item in node.items):

        lock_scopes.append(node.lineno)
